comments.snippet:
Thanks — a couple of notes on this auto-filed report.

The crash comes from the WinForms per-monitor DPI path: on `WM_DPICHANGED_BEFOREPARENT` the framework rescales the font of a `ComboBox`, which forces the control to destroy and re-create its window handle, and that re-creation failed (`Error creating a window handle`).
